evidence.why: Complete canonical helper body supports the corrected count and behavior.

facts.rationale: Directly counted the 27 active initializer entries; commented-out entries are not members. The complete body establishes the random gates, output changes, and universal fallback.
facts.value: The helper has no helper-owned persistent state, though its random calls consume RNG state. A nonzero HSD_Randi(2) result permits a player-relative attempt only for one of 27 explicitly enabled GrKind entries. It then selects one of four player slots and succeeds immediately if that slot has an entity, loading its coordinates, replacing y with the upper blast boundary minus 5, and adding an integer x offset from -50 through 49. Every unsuccessful or skipped preferred attempt falls through to Stage_80224FDC and returns its success status.

evidence.why: Factory initialization, cleanup, attachment, and scheduling.

facts.rationale: Distinguishes the factory's syntactic NULL branch from the actual failure behavior of its called helper.
facts.value: Initializes selected Ground flags, clears callback and auxiliary pointers, and sets eight x20 entries to -1. Primary GObj allocation failure returns NULL; Ground payload allocation failure destroys the GObj and returns NULL. The appended JObj is obtained through get_jobj_inline, which reports and loops forever if its load returns NULL; consequently that failure does not reach the factory's later NULL cleanup branch. Success attaches the helper-produced JObj and registers Ground processes at priorities 1 and 4.

evidence.why: Complete registration and membership bodies establish each branch.

facts.rationale: Corrects the baseline's unconditional null-input interpretation while preserving its supported duplicate-safe and first-fit behavior.
facts.value: Registration first scans for pointer identity and returns without mutation on a match. Otherwise it stores the pointer in the lowest-index null slot; exhaustion triggers HSD_ASSERT at source assertion line 2381. Null input is a no-op only when an unused null slot exists; if all slots are nonnull, null input reaches the exhaustion assertion. The adjacent membership predicate compares four entries, including null entries.

evidence.why: Complete control flow and saved versus reread map-ID expressions.

facts.rationale: Corrects the unconditional-callback assertion, preserves the explicit guards and distinguishes destruction submission from immediate reclamation. It also avoids assuming that callbacks cannot alter the payload's map ID.
facts.value: Null input returns immediately. Every non-null input is submitted to HSD_GObjPLink_80390228, which can defer reclamation of the currently executing object. Ground-specific work requires non-null user data: x1C_callback is invoked only when present; the matching registry slot is cleared by identity; Ground_801C55AC is called; and a present auxiliary object is removed and submitted to destruction. When the primary HSD object exists and the saved map ID's flag is zero, the flag is set before Ground_801C3128. Archive-dependent cleanup occurs only after a successful archive lookup. The archive lookup and first cleanup argument reread gp->map_id, while the archive entry index uses the earlier saved map_id.

facts.value: Exact signature: bool Ground_801C4D70(HSD_GObj* arg0, Vec3* arg1, f32 arg8). The position pointer is not declared const, although this body only reads through it.
